ground.visualReview: A2x2 repeat and live projected-ground scrolling showed no obvious seam at native game display scale.

motionReview.views: All five species have separately generated front, back, right and left art. Back views have no forward-facing eyes; anatomy and identity reviewed in contact sheets and the local browser.
motionReview.contact: All 20 six-frame actions use 600ms native cycles, with index3 contact at330ms. Rules and renderer share the timing contract; helpers finish recovery before moving.
motionReview.scale: Constant view and animation scales measured from ready body height; no per-frame resizing. Feet share the ground anchor.
motionReview.limit: Short six-frame cycles can show small shape changes. Exact same-foot contact across every transition, real mobile-device performance and human playtest enjoyment are unverified.
